scenes.heading: Keep your intake form short enough to finish

sents.d: Keep your intake form short enough to finish
A long intake form feels like homework, and the people who abandon it never book.
Someone who opens twelve questions tells themselves they will come back later.
Many never do, and you never hear from them.
Keep only the questions that tell you whether this person is a fit and what they want.
Save the deeper ones for the first session, then time yourself filling the form in on your phone.

take: Five to seven questions, answerable in under four minutes.
